resources.string: Open SpotiOS and sign in so the server can start.
Spotify is open. Tap to start SpotiOS Server so you can play on it.
Your phone restarted. Tap to start SpotiOS Server so it’s ready on Spotify Connect.
SpotiOS Server stopped. Tap to start it again.
How do you want to use SpotiOS?
You can switch any time in Settings.
The full SpotiOS app. Browse, search and play right here.
SpotiOS runs in the background as a speaker on Spotify Connect. Open your normal Spotify app, pick “SpotiOS” from the devices list and play through it.
Keeps running when you swipe it away or lock the phone
Takes the music over the moment your phone’s Spotify app plays
Shows what’s playing, and you can still pick songs
SpotiOS stays on in the background as a Spotify Connect device. Pick it in the devices list of your normal Spotify app, on this phone or any other device, and the music plays through SpotiOS.
On. Ready on Spotify Connect, even when SpotiOS is swiped away
Off. SpotiOS works as a normal app
SpotiOS starts when Spotify plays on this phone
Needs notification access. Tap to allow it
Server mode works best with battery optimization off for SpotiOS. It keeps the phone lightly awake so Spotify can always reach it, which uses some battery.
